name: DesignApp sources
description: The Design app (vector and UI design): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/DesignApp, built on SuiteUI's SuiteWindow and EditorDetail: the window and its intents (DesignWindow, DesignIntent), the window toolbar's commands (DesignToolbarItem), the floating tool palette, the canvas with selection handles (drawn above the page clip) and the inline text editor, the sidebar (a List of the pages and the layer tree), the Properties inspector (with its Align row in DesignAlignBar), the File, Edit, Page, Object (Align) and View menus, and the open and save panels.
